basis: Visible platform faces in source railway frame 19. The opposite platform lies above the upper boundary; the near platform lies left of the lower boundary.
selection: Image-boundary review; no threshold search. Person detector threshold remains 0.5.
rule: Footpoint membership is a review candidate only. Seated-edge contact and occlusion require abstention; geometry alone cannot establish physical descent.
evaluation_partition: All 26 existing frames are calibration. No held-out source event is available.
